title: Localizing closure of perfect complexes
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], let D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] be its quasi-coherent derived category and let D_{\mathrm{perf}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-perfect-complex] be its perfect objects. The perfect localizing closure is the smallest strictly full subcategory of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) containing every object of D_{\mathrm{perf}}(\mathcal O_X) and closed under shifts, cones, retracts, and arbitrary set-indexed direct sums.
